title: Grateful Dead Live at Omaha Civic Auditorium on 1978-07-05
lineage: 1st Generation: Master played back on Sony 158> Nak 550 Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: 1st Generation cassette played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0> (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding

ai_review.summary: A clean audience recording at the correct speed/pitch that captures a standout Sugaree performance.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about this tape’s accurate speed and relatively low noise, noting only slight muffling of vocals and bass. The musical highlight is the Sugaree, which one reviewer calls the best you’ll ever hear. Overall sentiment is very positive, with high marks for both sound and playing.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are favorable (4‑5 stars). The show receives strong praise for Sugaree, while the recording is praised for correct speed/pitch and low static despite minor muffling.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Correct speed/pitch compared to other sources; minimal static; vocals and bass are a little muffled when turned up high.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing or structure were provided.
